summary: LibreChat is a self-hosted, ChatGPT-compatible interface designed to connect with various artificial intelligence providers through a single web dashboard. It includes multi-user authentication, message history search functionality, and support for extensible plugins. The project is distributed under the MIT licence and built on Node.js.
goodFor: It suits administrators who want to host a centralised, multi-user AI chat interface with support for multiple upstream model providers.
watchOut: Managing API keys, user permissions, and upstream rate limits across multiple providers introduces ongoing operational overhead. It also duplicates the functionality of various native vendor applications.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running the application via Docker alongside a persistent database for storing user data and message history, fronted by a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
